profile.name: Maya Chen
profile.bio: Building a portfolio of research, competition, and leadership — aiming for engineering and public policy in college.

years.tagline: Junior year — research, debate, and college prep in motion.

events.heading1: AP Research — urban heat island study
events.body: Designed a semester-long study comparing surface temperatures across three neighborhoods using open satellite data and local sensor readings. Presented preliminary findings to our science department and submitted the abstract to a regional high school research symposium.
Led weekly case drills for eight teammates, researched climate policy briefs, and earned a bid to the state tournament after placing 2nd at the Metro Invitational.
Partnered on Anatomy & Physiology and Forensics events. Gold in both at regionals; placed 4th in Forensics at state after rebuilding our evidence binder twice in the final week.
Auditioned with a Chopin prelude and was selected for the county honor ensemble. Performed at the spring concert and logged 120+ practice hours across the season.
Organized peer tutoring blocks for underclassmen in algebra and chemistry. Co-led a campus supply drive that collected 400+ items for a local shelter.
Built a low-cost air quality monitor with Arduino and placed honorable mention at the district fair. This project sparked my interest in urban environmental data.
Learned cross-examination structure and competed in five novice tournaments. Finished the season with a winning record and a nomination for most improved.
